Meccano window panel

One panel fits any of the three front windows. Same panel rules as the GX plates; the area over the opening is drilled on the Meccano grid. Drag to orbit, scroll or pinch to zoom.

The panel

  • 172 × 79 × 3 mm plate (opening + 14.5 all round), rounded to match the window.
  • 44 Meccano holes, Ø4.1 on a 12.7 mm grid (11 × 4), over the opening only.
  • 4 countersunk M3 holes into the window rivnuts, Ø9 × 1.2 flange reliefs behind, 2 mm locating lip.

Using it

  • Bolt on switches, LEDs, labels or Meccano brackets with M4 or 5/32" bolts and nuts from inside.
  • Print face down, black PETG, no supports. Screws: 4 × M3 × 6 countersunk.
